name: iam:* on Resource * (positive, de-flooded to one primary)
note: iam:* is a service wildcard (WILDCARD-ACTION, high), a direct-IAM-admin grant (DIRECT-IAM-ADMIN, high per the IAM-102 severity model), non-read on Resource "*" (WILDCARD-RESOURCE), AND - because iam:* covers every IAM action - it also expands into every specific IAM escalation primitive (ATTACH-POLICY, PUT-INLINE-POLICY, POLICY-VERSION, TRUST-POLICY-MODIFY, CREDENTIAL-CREATION). exactFindingIds is the pre-correlation RULE set (rules.js only). IAM-705 de-floods the acceptance-suite test-12 iam:* case: rather than 7 near-duplicate top-level rows, the whole iam:* grant is presented as ONE primary broad-IAM-administration finding (DIRECT-IAM-ADMIN) with the specific primitives + the iam:* WILDCARD-ACTION folded in as subsumed techniques / risk factors, and the same-statement WILDCARD-RESOURCE folded in as the resource-scope factor (IAM-201). Severity stays high, consistent with the single documented IAM-102 scoring model (critical is reserved for compound privilege-boundary-crossing paths; a broad IAM-admin surface is not one). The rule-catalog version is surfaced on the result (catalogVersion). Because everything is folded into the one primary, all four highlighted summary families are 0 - the primary row itself carries the escalation surface.
